description: Everything known about one family: weights, styles, subsets, formats and serving provider, plus its category, use-case tags, foundry and the foundry's own description of the design. Read this before choosing — it is what distinguishes one name from another. Variable fonts report weight as a range like '100 900', and list every axis they carry under variableAxes — width, optical size, slant, and any expressive axes the typeface defines.
name: font_properties
title: Inspect a family
